name: SOSA specification examples: Deployments
abstract: Examples from the SOSA/SSN specification whose root resource is a deployments resource. Each Turtle example is validated against the SHACL rules of `ogc.sosa.properties.deployment`, and converted to JSON-LD by the `ttl-to-jsonld` transform, whose output is validated against the `ogc.sosa.properties.deployment` building block (JSON Schema, JSON-LD context and SHACL).
